content:
- Select Details and review the filter query.
- Make sure the filter includes all the work types and statuses you want to see on your board and backlog.
Verify status-to-column mapping
- Next to your board’s name in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Board settings.
- Expand the remainder of the menu in the sidebar by selecting Layout.
- Select Columns.
- Ensure all statuses you want to appear on the board are mapped to a column.
Enable the backlog feature
- Next to the name of your space in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Space settings.
- Select Features.
- Make sure the Backlog feature is enabled.
Check status mapping for backlog
- Next to your board’s name in the sidebar, select More actions (•••), then Board settings.
- Expand the remainder of the menu in the sidebar by selecting Layout.
- Select Columns.
- Ensure that statuses intended for the backlog are mapped to the “Backlog” column if available.
